title: MT to MX Field Mapping Schema
description: JSON Schema for MT to ISO 20022 MX message field mapping definitions. This schema validates the structure of bidirectional field mappings used by the translation engine.

message_pair.description: The MT and MX message type pair (e.g., 'MT103/pacs.008.001.10')

mx_type.description: The ISO 20022 MX message type with version (e.g., 'pacs.008.001.10')

description.description: Brief description of this message pair and its usage

mapping_notes.description: General notes about this mapping that apply to multiple fields

mt_field_name.description: The descriptive name of the MT field

mt_option.description: The option letter for fields with multiple formats (A/B/C/D/F/K). Null if field has no options.

mx_path.description: XPath-like path to the MX element (e.g., 'GrpHdr/MsgId', 'CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/EndToEndId')

transform_type.description: Type of transformation: direct (1:1 copy), split (1 MT field -> multiple MX elements), merge (multiple MT fields -> 1 MX element), lookup (code translation via table), derived (calculated/generated value), conditional (depends on other field values)

transform_details.description: Detailed explanation of the transformation logic, especially for split/merge/lookup/derived/conditional types

direction.description: Direction of translation: mt_to_mx (MT to MX only), mx_to_mt (MX to MT only), both (bidirectional)

data_loss_risk.description: Risk of data loss: none (full fidelity), possible (may lose data in some scenarios), certain (data loss expected)

truncation_rule.description: Truncation rule when mapping MX to MT (e.g., 'MX allows 140 chars, MT max 35 chars per line over 4 lines')

default_value.description: Default value to use when target field is required but source is missing or empty

validation_rules.description: Validation rules that apply during transformation

examples.description: Example transformations showing MT value -> MX value or vice versa

notes.description: Additional notes about this specific mapping

mt_only_fields.description: MT fields that have no MX equivalent and will be lost when translating MT to MX

reason.description: Explanation of why this field has no MX equivalent

mx_only_fields.description: MX elements that have no MT equivalent and must be defaulted when translating MX to MT

default_strategy.description: Strategy for providing a value when translating from MT (e.g., 'use constant', 'derive from other fields', 'require user input')

reason.description: Explanation of why this field has no MT equivalent
